empirical_core_test.description: Empirical ex-ante-core validation on the fixed synthetic token tree setting. A maximum coalition improvement of 1 means no coalition can block the submitted stochastic policy.

max_coalition_improvement.description: Worst proportional improvement available to any coalition across the slice.

mean_coalition_improvement.description: Average blocking pressure across instances, which catches methods that pass only by hiding a few extreme failures.

coalition_violation_rate.description: Fraction of instances where at least one coalition can improve beyond the core threshold.

core_constraint_satisfied.description: Indicator that the worst coalition improvement stays at or below the core threshold.

distribution_simplex_l1_error.description: Maximum simplex violation of the submitted lottery before evaluator normalization.

min_agent_expected_utility.description: Worst expected utility received by any participant under the submitted lottery.

rho_0_max_coalition_improvement.description: Worst coalition improvement on unpolarized synthetic instances.

rho_1_max_coalition_improvement.description: Worst coalition improvement at polarization rho=1.

rho_2_max_coalition_improvement.description: Worst coalition improvement at polarization rho=2.

rho_4_max_coalition_improvement.description: Worst coalition improvement at polarization rho=4.

rho_8_max_coalition_improvement.description: Worst coalition improvement at polarization rho=8.
